decision: PHASE-0-DECISIONS D-001: the navigational accent is authored, not measured. Candidates must pass ACCENT_CONTRAST (tools/assets/accent.mjs); the H2.5 feel test picks one. Until then `default` is what ships, and ?accent=<name> switches the torii in place.

area.rule: ACCENT_AREA (D-003): at the gameplay follow framing — the player ahead_m before a torii along the critical path, camera at CAMERA_TUNING's rest pose — the accent's share of the frame must lie in [floor_pct, ceiling]. Asserted by the harness `accent` stage, per torii, per level.
area.floor_basis: PROVISIONAL until H2.5. Measured 2026-11-08: kit_torii's accent share with the torii 25.26 u from the camera (STYLE-BIBLE 3 near-band edge, 25 u): the next waypoint must still read as a near-band form. docs/build-log/accent/accent-area-curve.json. Frozen as a number, so a smaller gate fails it rather than moving it.
area.ceiling: min share in reference/palette.json (ink-black 5.08%), read at run time: the accent never covers more of the frame than the least-used value of the ramp, so it stays a signal and never competes with the structure.
